title: GitHub gh-aw MCP argument injection can bypass intended command safeguards
product: GitHub gh-aw CLI and MCP server
summary: In gh-aw versions before v0.91.12, MCP handlers appended untrusted client strings into child-process argv without a `--` separator or leading-hyphen rejection. A lower-trust MCP client could inject supported flags to bypass workflow security controls and perform credential-backed GitHub operations. GHSL assigns identifier GHSL-2026-180 and the repository advisory GHSA-f7r8-5pqp-q5p4; no CVE is assigned.
ai_role: The published repository advisory explicitly says Taskflow Agent discovered the issue and GHSL manually verified it. It identifies the AI system and human verification separately; no priority claim is needed.
classification_note: The advisory says the fix was included in v0.91.12 published October 14, 2026; that version is marked pre-release.
remediation_note: Patched in gh-aw v0.91.12, published October 14, 2026 and marked pre-release. The advisory recommends v0.91.12 or later; downstream deployment is not verified.
